def solve(facts):
    subtotal = 0
    for line in facts["lines"]:
        discount = Fraction(line["discount_percent"])
        amount = Fraction(line["qty"] * line["unit_cents"]) * (1 - discount / 100)
        subtotal += (2 * amount.numerator + amount.denominator) // (2 * amount.denominator)
    tax_rate = Fraction(facts["tax_percent"])
    tax_amount = Fraction(subtotal) * tax_rate / 100
    tax = (2 * tax_amount.numerator + tax_amount.denominator) // (2 * tax_amount.denominator)
    return {"subtotal_cents": subtotal, "tax_cents": tax, "total_cents": subtotal + tax + facts["shipping"]}

def check(answer, facts):
    subtotal = 0
    for line in facts["lines"]:
        q = Fraction(line["discount_percent"])
        n = line["qty"] * line["unit_cents"] * (100 * q.denominator - q.numerator)
        d = 100 * q.denominator
        subtotal += (2 * n + d) // (2 * d)
    t = Fraction(facts["tax_percent"])
    n = subtotal * t.numerator
    d = 100 * t.denominator
    tax = (2 * n + d) // (2 * d)
    return answer == {"subtotal_cents": subtotal, "tax_cents": tax, "total_cents": subtotal + tax + facts["shipping"]}"}
